testData: Project "Preview demo" is seeded at startup with tickets whose titles start with [seed]: three merged tickets with completed agent executions (Claude and Codex, spread over three weeks), a relaunched ticket in the done column with an open PR (a failed first execution, then a successful one), a legacy merged ticket without executions or a precise implementation start, a failed ticket and a TODO ticket. Four more [seed] tickets have the autonomous Devin option active: "Ticket Devin à faire" (TODO, no frozen plan yet), "Ticket Devin en correction" (implementing, phase correcting, 1 correction, E2E failure message), "Ticket Devin en pause" (failed column, phase paused, 1 correction, deadline exceeded message) and "Ticket Devin livré" (merged with PR #106, phase completed, no correction). Their board cards show a "Devin" marker with the current phase and their Overview tab shows the read-only Devin stepper. The statistics page therefore shows durations, costs and weekly deliveries. Agents are simulated (KANBAN_DRY_RUN=1): no real session, pull request or merge happens, and launching a ticket only runs a simulated flow. The application has no login.
